items_flat.title_en: OpenAI upgrades GPT-6 Pro in ChatGPT with parallel agents and collaborative Slides
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 升級 ChatGPT 中的 GPT-6 Pro，加入平行代理與協作簡報功能
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced that GPT-6 Pro in the Chat tab now delivers faster responses, better plugin and tool use, and support for multiple agents working on different parts of a task in parallel, with visible progress tracking. The company also introduced ChatGPT Slides for creating, editing, and real-time collaborative presentations that can be exported to PowerPoint, PDF, or Google Slides.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布 ChatGPT 中的 GPT-6 Pro 現提供更快回應、更好的外掛與工具使用，並支援多個代理平行處理任務不同部分，且可追蹤進度。同時推出 ChatGPT Slides，可建立、編輯並即時協作簡報，並匯出至 PowerPoint、PDF 或 Google Slides。
items_flat.analysis_en: Parallel agents mark a concrete step from single-threaded chat toward multi-agent workflows inside the consumer product, though availability is still limited to Pro users and real-world reliability remains to be proven at scale.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 平行代理代表從單一對話轉向產品內多代理工作流的具體進展，但目前僅限 Pro 用戶，大規模實際可靠性仍待驗證。
items_flat.quote: GPT-6 Pro in the chat tab now offers: Faster responses. Improved use of plugins and tools to carry out tasks. Multiple agents that can work on different parts of a task in parallel.
items_flat.quote_zh: ChatGPT 中的 GPT-6 Pro 現提供：更快回應。改善外掛與工具使用以完成任務。多個代理可平行處理任務的不同部分。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic reports junior technical hiring drop and agents logging 6x human hours
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 報告初級技術招聘下降，代理工時達人類 6 倍
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic published research showing that the share of junior technical hires fell from 27% to 9% over roughly a year, while technical roles as a share of the workforce declined from 61% to 56%. By August 2026, employee-directed Claude agents were logging six times more active work hours than humans, with productivity metrics such as code commits per engineer rising substantially.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 發布研究指出，初級技術招聘占比約一年內從 27% 降至 9%，技術角色占整體人力從 61% 降至 56%。到 2026 年 8 月，員工指揮的 Claude 代理活躍工時已達人類 6 倍，工程師程式碼提交等生產力指標大幅提升。
items_flat.analysis_en: The data offers a rare inside view of how heavy agent adoption can reshape hiring and work composition at a frontier lab, though Anthropic notes its AI-native workflows may not fully generalize to traditional companies.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這些數據提供了前沿實驗室重度採用代理後如何重塑招聘與工作組成的罕見內部視角，但 Anthropic 指出其 AI 原生工作流未必能完全套用到傳統企業。
items_flat.quote: By August, there were six times more agents than employees at Anthropic, and productivity increased.
items_flat.quote_zh: 到八月，Anthropic 的代理數量已是員工的六倍，生產力也隨之提升。

items_flat.title_en: DeepSeek releases V4.1-Flash-1017 with stronger agent scores and open weights
items_flat.title_zh: DeepSeek 釋出 V4.1-Flash-1017，代理分數提升並開放權重
items_flat.summary_en: DeepSeek shipped DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, a minor update to its previous Flash model that improves scores across agentic and coding benchmarks (including 77.0 on DeepSWE v1.1 versus 74.0 for Claude Opus 5 in the company’s table), finishes tasks faster, and produces shorter outputs. Weights are available on Hugging Face under MIT, and the company opened Search and Fetch APIs.
items_flat.summary_zh: DeepSeek 推出 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017，為先前 Flash 模型的小幅更新，在代理與程式碼基準上分數提升（公司表格中 DeepSWE v1.1 達 77.0，對比 Claude Opus 5 的 74.0），任務完成更快且輸出更短。權重以 MIT 授權釋出於 Hugging Face，並開放 Search 與 Fetch API。
items_flat.analysis_en: The update strengthens the cost-performance case for open-weight agentic models relative to closed frontier options on specific coding benchmarks, though independent verification of the claimed gains is still limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此更新強化了開放權重代理模型在特定程式碼基準上相對封閉前沿模型的成本效能優勢，但宣稱提升的獨立驗證仍有限。
items_flat.quote: Stronger benchmark performance, faster task completion, and shorter outputs than the previous version—a Pareto improvement in performance and cost.
items_flat.quote_zh: 比先前版本更強的基準表現、更快的任務完成與更短的輸出——在效能與成本上的帕累托改進。

items_flat.title_en: Meta removes controversial AI training language from updated commercial terms after backlash
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 在引發反彈後，從更新商業條款中移除爭議性 AI 訓練用語
items_flat.summary_en: Meta updated its commercial terms and then removed language that critics said could allow the company to crawl business customers’ websites and use the content to train AI models. A Meta spokesperson stated the crawling provisions only applied to ads and business products and that the revision clarified existing practices without changing how Meta uses web crawlers.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 更新商業條款後，移除了批評者認為可能允許公司爬取商業客戶網站並用內容訓練 AI 模型的用語。Meta 發言人表示爬取條款僅適用於廣告與商業產品，修訂是為釐清既有做法，並未改變 Meta 使用網頁爬蟲的方式。
items_flat.analysis_en: The rapid walk-back highlights ongoing sensitivity around web-crawling rights for AI training, especially for publishers, even as Meta maintains there was no substantive change in practice.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 快速撤回凸顯 AI 訓練網頁爬取權利的持續敏感性，尤其對出版商而言，即使 Meta 堅持實務上並無實質改變。
items_flat.quote: We’ve heard you and want to clarify: the crawling terms we consolidated only applied to our ads and business products, and we’ve clarified that in the terms themselves.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們聽到你們的意見並想澄清：我們整合的爬取條款僅適用於廣告與商業產品，我們已在條款中加以釐清。

items_flat.title_en: OpenCode reports breach exposing OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google API keys for some users
items_flat.title_zh: OpenCode 報告安全漏洞，部分用戶的 OpenAI、Anthropic 與 Google API 金鑰可能外洩
items_flat.summary_en: OpenCode disclosed unauthorized access to a legacy system it was decommissioning, stating that third-party provider API keys (including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google) saved by about 1.4% of Console users may have been exposed in what it described as a large-scale distillation attack. The company said it notified affected users and is working with the providers to remediate.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenCode 揭露其正在淘汰的舊系統遭未授權存取，指出約 1.4% Console 用戶儲存的第三方供應商 API 金鑰（包括 OpenAI、Anthropic 與 Google）可能外洩，並將其描述為大規模蒸餾攻擊。公司表示已通知受影響用戶，並正與供應商合作處理。
items_flat.analysis_en: The incident underscores the security risks of third-party tools that store frontier-lab API keys, with limited public detail so far on the full scope or confirmed misuse beyond initial user reports of unauthorized charges.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此事件凸顯儲存前沿實驗室 API 金鑰的第三方工具安全風險，目前公開細節有限，除初步用戶報告的未授權扣款外，完整範圍或確認濫用情況仍不明。
items_flat.quote: We had a security breach last night related to a large scale distillation attack that impacted 1.4% of OpenCode Console users.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們昨晚發生與大規模蒸餾攻擊相關的安全漏洞，影響了 1.4% 的 OpenCode Console 用戶。

DeepSeek shipped an improved open-weight Flash update with stronger agent scores, while Meta walked back controversial commercial terms language on web crawling for AI training.
